Name: development-4
Purpose: The figures of the sprints before the gates, for comparison between sprints only, from Epic 1, sprint S10 on: the same machine and versions as the manifests development to development-3, with a run in which a master and its children are instances of one process, connected over the loopback interface. No figure under this manifest judges a gate, and the manifest needs no approval (docs/work/epic-1/acceptance.md, rules for every measurement).

Machine.Processor: Intel Core i9-13900H, 14 cores, 20 logical processors
Machine.Memory: 64 GiB DDR5, two modules of 32 GiB at 5,200 MT/s

Virtualization: None: the program runs on the operating system, in no container and no virtual machine
Run: One process, started by hand from src with dotnet run in the Release configuration, on a machine without other heavy work; a master and the children that load from it are instances of the engine in that process, connected over TCP on the loopback interface, and a child loads while nothing else runs
